messages:
alex: Heads-up: code freeze in ~2h for v1.12.0. Night shift handoff — please hold non-critical merges. I have a late PR (#4921) that fixes a flake in kv-cache; it's small but touches runtime. Requesting late-merge exception if green.

maria: What's the risk? Can it wait until next patch?

alex: Small. Prevents intermittent perf regression seen in staging (kv-cache hit-rate drop). CI flaky on `kv_cache_test::eviction_race` — patch adds a tiny guard and a unit test. Passed local runs. Would prefer to get this into RC rather than a post-release patch.

devon: Do we have a changelog owner for this? Need a one-liner and component tag.

alex: I'll add a 1-liner to the changelog under "runtime: kv-cache". PR description includes notes.

sam: (release-bot) Reminder: freeze policy — late merges require release manager + runtime lead approval and a canary on staging. See <https://go/release-freeze>. :information_source:

taylor: If @maria signs off, +1 from runtime team. Suggest canary on staging for 30m before merging to main.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4921
CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4821/builds/224
Cherry-pick command (if needed):
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b cherry/1.12.0-pr4921 origin/release/v1.12.0
git cherry-pick <commit-hash>
git push origin cherry/1.12.0-pr4921
```

release-bot: Exception logged: EXC-2026-45 for PR #4921 — pending manual approvals.

maria: Ok — adding to freeze-exceptions doc and approving pending staging canary results. Please tag me when staging is healthy. :white_check_mark:

kai: Oncall monitoring. Will watch p99 latency and error rate for 2h after merge. Will ping here on anomalies.

alex: Thanks all — will kick off canary now and post results in ~20m. :rocket:
